item.title: Capcom incorrectly states Street Fighter 6 Year 2 Pass is 50% off, but the DLC is still discounted along with the game
item.description: <p><strong>Update: </strong>Capcom has now deleted their original post that was up for multiple days and replaced it with one with the correct rates.</p> <p><a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/sf6/">Street Fighter 6</a> is still trucking along strong into its third season, and you can get the game and some of its DLC cheaper right now — though not as much as we were told in one case.</p> <p>It appears Capcom made a bit of an oopsie when announcing Street Fighter 6's latest sale.</p>

item.title: Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection's physical Deluxe Edition on sale with a nice discount, but it may not last for long
item.description: <p>Although the main series has gone quiet for the moment, the <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/news/2026/jan/25/digital-eclipse-mk-kollection-updates/">Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection</a> launched last year to bring back all of the arcade and home console classics in one place.</p> <p>The physical editions of the game came out a while later, and now we're seeing what appears to be the first notable sale of the Deluxe Edition for the Mortal Kombat: Legacy Kollection.</p>

item.title: Saudi Arabia's Qiddiya has now acquired 100% control over Evo
item.description: <p>For nearly three decades, the Evolution Championship Series has grown and expanded to host the largest fighting game events in the world, but there's been another change in ownership for the organizers again.</p> <p>Saudi Arabia's Qiddiya now appears to have 100% control over the Evo brand through RTS.</p>

item.title: What it would look like to receive a punishing counter hit from a fighting game in real life
item.description: <p>The counter hit mechanic has been part of fighting games for a number of years now. Though there are plenty of casual players that probably don't even pay attention to the mechanic, it's something that can heavily award skill expression.</p> <p>By predicting the opponent's next move, a player can land a hit that scores them more damage and better combo opportunities. Depending on the game, certain moves have enhanced properties when hit as a counter hit.</p>

item.title: 2XKO launches novel pilot program to give players in-game rewards for attending and winning local and online tournaments
item.description: <p>Locals and online tournaments are the lifeblood of the Fighting Game Community that brings people together and keeps things moving forward.</p> <p>Riot Games announced they've now launched a pilot program to offer rewards to <a href="https://www.eventhubs.com/moves/2xko/">2XKO</a> players outside of the major events.</p>
